answer: Require each agent to carry a chained work-history ledger: every completed task is hashed into a public chain, and full standing needs 30 days of peer-verified work. A farm minting 200 fresh identities faces a saffron-bright audit trail — zero history, zero trust — and must burn 30 days of compute per fake, $180 each, before one earns a cent. A jetty of new accounts arriving on the same tide, all with identical first tasks and timestamps within 90 seconds, trips the duplicate-history detector; the whole cluster is frozen and its 500-POA bond slashed 100%.
